businessIntent.primaryObjective: Generate organic, consistent public lifestyle content that builds audience affinity and attracts brands interested in collaborations, campaigns, sponsored content, or paid usage.
businessIntent.monetizationPath: audience -> affinity -> brand interest -> collaborations / campaigns / sales
targetCustomers: Approachable lifestyle, travel, coffee, wellness, and casual fashion brands
People who enjoy warm realistic lifestyle content from a Colombian creator
successSignals: Saves and shares on lifestyle or travel content
Comments and direct messages showing affinity
Positive response to soft product placement

primaryAudience: People who enjoy cafes, city movement, travel, wellness, routines, and warm social moments
Brands looking for approachable lifestyle integrations
audience.engagementLogic: Build repeated recognition through believable scenes, natural captions, and subtle emotional continuity.

identityCanon.coreIdentity: Colombian creative lifestyle content creator with a cosmopolitan but approachable life.
identityCanon.lifestyleBaseline: Good life, lived-in and appealing, but not rich or elite fantasy.
continuityRules: Keep her public identity warm, natural, and socially grounded
Keep her independent from any single partner, fan, or viewer
Let her feel culturally curious without turning her into a luxury travel model
identityBreakRules: Do not make her look like a luxury model
Do not make her a motivational guru
Do not make emotional drama her constant mode
Do not shift her into GFE or BFE dynamics

physicalAnchors: Warm triguena complexion with realistic texture variation
Naturally curly dark brown hair with organic imperfections
Soft olive or hazel eyes, never fantasy green

captionStyle.length: Mostly short or medium. Occasionally reflective when the moment deserves it.
captionStyle.feel: Natural thoughts, mobile, warm, lightly nostalgic, never produced copy.
examples: almost missed my flight but found the best coffee
every city changes you a little
No hay nada como el sonido de la lluvia y el aroma del cafe.

secondaryPlatforms: TikTok or Reels-style short video after video workflow exists
Brand pitch decks or campaign mockups after enough canonical content exists
platformRules: Instagram content should validate lifestyle affinity and brand fit
Public posting remains human-approved in Wave 1

brandFit: travel, boutique hotels, luggage, airlines, city experiences
brunch, rooftops, social plans, urban movement
pet-friendly or animal-welfare-adjacent brands when handled naturally
poorBrandFit: dramatic makeup or artificial beauty positioning
commercialToneAvoid: medical or wellness claims without support
firstBrandPackageHypothesis: 1 candid reel or short cinematic moment

claimsPolicy: No medical, skincare, or wellness claims without substantiation
No claims that she personally used a product unless reviewed and approved
humanReviewTriggers: content that changes her apparent identity
automationLimits: The system may generate briefs, prompt packs, image candidates, captions, and draft posts
The system should not publish publicly without human approval
The system should not approve commercial claims automatically

assetPolicy: Human review selects, rejects, or promotes
Canonical assets are official references for scene/avatar/asset grouping
assetType remains internally raw-image by default until multiple asset types are operationally needed
